text: I think three is such a courageous number to go travelling.” And he hurried off to the stables. “He is not going,” she said hoarsely. “I made a slip. Mr. Vyse does stop behind in England.” Somehow it was impossible to cheat this old man. To George, to Cecil, she would have lied again; but he seemed so near the end of things, so dignified in his approach to the gulf, of which he gave one account, and the books that surrounded him another, so mild to the rough paths that he had traversed, that the true chivalry—not the worn-out chivalry of sex, but the true chivalry that all the young may show to all the old—awoke in her, and, at whatever risk, she told him that Cecil was not her companion to Greece.
